verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit is a code-review SaaS platform, so it could plausibly publish an official MCP server and the axis applies. The pack shows no such server. The MCP evidence (docs-12, and 'MCP connections' on the pricing page) describes CodeRabbit consuming external MCP servers as a client-side context source, which is not credited here. The Claude Code integration runs through the CLI, not through a CodeRabbit-hosted MCP endpoint.
